patch_description:
The current program introduces problematic CRZ gates with extreme parameter sharing (4 gates, 1 parameter) on diagonal qubit pairs, which causes severe convergence issues (2160 steps vs 90 in Program 2). The worst_group_margin also degraded significantly (0.28 vs 0.31).

Program 2 achieved the best score (0.59) with a cleaner structure using distinct Ising gate parameters (XX, YY, ZZ) on specific qubit pairs, avoiding the convergence pitfalls of the current design.

This edit removes the problematic CRZ diagonal layer and restores the proven Ising interaction pattern from Program 2, which:
- Eliminates the extreme parameter sharing that blocks gradient flow
- Uses targeted two-qubit couplings (0-1, 2-3, 4-5, 6-7, 1-4, 3-6) that have proven effective
- Simplifies the structure (fewer gates, better trainability)
- Restores the final RZ post-processing layer which contributes to margin quality
- Expected to recover convergence speed and worst-group margin performance
